Dated this the 05th day of February, 2026 The victim in Crime No.826 of 2019 of Fort Kochi Police Station, Ernakulam which is now pending as SC No.1834 of 2024 on the files of Additional District and Sessions Court for the trial of cases relating to atrocities and sexual violence against women and children, Ernakulam filed this Criminal M.C. under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (B.N.S.S) praying for quashing all further proceedings against the accused/4th respondent.

The offence alleged against the accused is under Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short the IPC).
2.

The prosecution case is that on 21.12.2018 at about 10:00 p.m. the accused after promising to marry the de facto complainant committed rape on her in an apartment at Fort Kochi, three times till 7:00 am on the next day.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the 4th respondent the entire dispute between them is now settled and she prays for quashing all further proceedings against 2026:KER:11119 him forthwith.

4. The petitioner filed an affidavit stating that the dispute has been settled with the 4th respondent Xxxxxx vs State Of Kerala on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181906829/
2 and also that she does not want to proceed against the 4th respondent.

entities.text: 4th respondent Xxxxxx vs State Of Kerala
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The 4th respondent also filed an affidavit.
5. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.

However, the learned Public Prosecutor submitted that the petitioner has given a sworn statement before the Station House Officer in tune with the averments in the affidavit filed by her before this Court.

6. On a perusal of the FI Statement, it is revealed that the petitioner accompanied the 4th respondent to a hotel during the night and it was at that time she was allegedly abused by the 4th respondent.
Therefore, prima facie, it reveals that the relationship between them was consensual.
The above conclusion is fortified by the fact that now the victim has filed an affidavit stating that she does not want to proceed against the 4th respondent.
Therefore, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the 4 th respondent as it will only be an abuse of the process of the court.
Therefore, this Criminal M.C. is allowed.

All further proceedings 2026:KER:11119 against the 4 th respondent in SC No.1834 of 2024 on the files of Additional District and Sessions Court for the trial of cases relating to atrocities and sexual violence against women and children, Ernakulam arising from Crime No.826 of 2019 of Fort Kochi Police Station, Ernakulam stands quashed under Section 528 of the B.N.S.S.
